Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
List revised.
Heard Ms. Rashmi Misra, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri S.B. Maurya, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicants Mohnish Shadiza and Madhukar Shadiza, with the prayer to quash the charge sheet no. 26/21, dated 8.3.2021 and cognizance order dated 25.6.2021 as well as entire proceedings in Case No. 90509 of 2021 (State vs.
Kamal Darani and others), under Sections 498A I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, arising out of Case Crime No. 33 of 2022, Police Station Swaroop Nagar, District Kanpur Nagar, pending before the Metropolitan Magistrate I, Kanpur Nagar and with further to stay the further proceedings of the aforesaid case.

sentences.text: After some arguments learned counsel for the applicants states that the applicant has been granted bail.
He further states that the present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. be dismissed as withdrawn as he intends to raise all the points available to him at the stage of trial.
Learned counsel for the State has no objection to the said proposition.
In these circumstances, the present application is dismissed as withdrawn.
